name: Keyword Density Checker
summary: Measure word and phrase density in your copy — locally in your browser.
description: Paste draft text to see total words, unique keywords, and density percentages. Ignore stop words, set a minimum length, track focus keywords or phrases, and review the top terms. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: How is density calculated?
faqs.answer: Density is occurrences ÷ total words × 100. Stop words can be excluded from the ranking list, but the denominator still uses all words.

faqs.question: Can I check multi-word phrases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add phrases to the focus field (one per line or comma-separated).

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Analysis runs entirely in your browser.
